steps.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
cache={}
for line in Path('"'"'build/CMakeCache.txt'"'"').read_text().splitlines():
 if '"'"'='"'"' in line and '"'"':'"'"' in line and not line.startswith(('"'"'//'"'"','"'"'#'"'"')):
  key,value=line.split('"'"'='"'"',1); name,_=key.split('"'"':'"'"',1); cache[name]=value
false_values={'"'"''"'"','"'"'0'"'"','"'"'OFF'"'"','"'"'NO'"'"','"'"'FALSE'"'"','"'"'N'"'"','"'"'IGNORE'"'"','"'"'NOTFOUND'"'"'}
def enabled(value):
 return value.upper() not in false_values and not value.upper().endswith('"'"'-NOTFOUND'"'"')
requirements={'"'"'SIMDUTF_TESTS'"'"': True, '"'"'BUILD_TESTING'"'"': True, '"'"'SIMDUTF_FAST_TESTS'"'"': False, '"'"'SIMDUTF_TOOLS'"'"': True}
for key,expected in requirements.items():
 assert key in cache, '"'"'缺少必要配置:'"'"'+key
 assert enabled(cache[key])==expected, '"'"'配置功能不符:'"'"'+key+'"'"'='"'"'+cache[key]
if True:
 assert not enabled(cache.get('"'"'BUILD_SHARED_LIBS'"'"','"'"'OFF'"'"')), '"'"'必须使用默认静态库构建'"'"'
print('"'"'FORGE_TASK_CONFIGURATION_OK'"'"')
' && python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess

assert rows[-1]=='"'"''"'"', '"'"'Git索引输出不完整'"'"'
names=rows[:-1]
actual=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(names),ensure_ascii=True,separators=('"'"','"'"','"'"':'"'"')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert actual=='"'"'efb8a0340eb270302aa3d730a2bb25a1db6a2af75f40c7c23da44e381cf8139d'"'"', '"'"'Git索引文件集合与固定原源码不同'"'"'

print('"'"'FORGE_SOURCE_INDEX_VERIFIED='"'"'+actual)

assert all(c.get('"'"'status'"'"','"'"'run'"'"')=='"'"'run'"'"' for c in cases), '"'"'存在未实际运行测试'"'"'
print('"'"'FORGE_CTEST_ACTUALLY_PASSED='"'"'+str(len(cases)))
' && python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess

assert rows[-1]=='"'"''"'"', '"'"'Git索引输出不完整'"'"'
names=rows[:-1]
actual=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(names),ensure_ascii=True,separators=('"'"','"'"','"'"':'"'"')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert actual=='"'"'efb8a0340eb270302aa3d730a2bb25a1db6a2af75f40c7c23da44e381cf8139d'"'"', '"'"'Git索引文件集合与固定原源码不同'"'"'
assert subprocess.run(['"'"'git'"'"','"'"'rev-parse'"'"','"'"'--verify'"'"','"'"'HEAD'"'"'],capture_output=True).returncode!=0, '"'"'不允许伪造源码commit'"'"'
